name: DeepSeekHarness
description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) is an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  dsh:
    command: null
    container_name: dsh-harness
    entrypoint: null
    image: ghcr.io/smanx/deepseek-harness:latest
    labels:
      icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/selfhst/icons@main/png/deepseek.png
    networks:
      - default
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 3080
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}
        target: /root/.dsh
        bind:
          create_host_path: true
